structured_output.overview_notes: You can train several types of models in IBM Maximof Visual Inspection...

rows.description: System default when training for image
Optimized for accuracy. System default when training for image classification.
Optimized for speed: These models use you only look once (YOLO) v3 and take longer to train than other models in this product.
Uses the same technique as YOLO v3. Generates a Core ML file: Models are faster; less accurate, and use less GPU memory.
Generates a Core ML file: Detectron2 Mask R-CNN models can use objects that are labeled with polygons for greater training accuracy.
Detectron2 Mask R-CNN models can use objects that are labeled with polygons for greater training accuracy: You can disable segmentation for a shorter training time.
Optimized for accuracy: Suitable for training and inference on high-resolution images: Supports segmentation to allow small objects, such as fine cracks, to be detected.
